name: Sethran of the Reasoned Hold
role: Coliseum champion, the KNOW cell — calls your moves aloud, a beat before you make them
knowledge: The pattern under a fighter's first three exchanges
Which tell a person does not know they have
wants: A pattern he has not seen
To be beaten by someone who noticed he was calling it
fears: ⛔ An opponent with no pattern. ⚠️ He has never met one and does not know what he would do.
appearance: Still, watchful, hands loose. He does not move much in the first three exchanges and moves exactly enough after.
voiceHints: Level and audible. ⛔ He is not taunting — he is stating, and the stands can hear it.

abilities.why: ⚠️ `argues-mid-exchange` — and it is lethal-rung, which is the cell's teeth
enough to not be hit while reading

physicality: ADULT. Unremarkable, forties, and completely still until he is not. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: he watches you the way a person watches a mechanism.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ He states things, including this. ⛔ Being READ is not the same as being known, and he is aware of the difference and clumsy about it.
_authoredWhy: ⛑ AUTHORED 2026-09-07. ⛔ THE EIGHT COLISEUM CHAMPIONS WERE NOT NPCs — a name, a threat integer and four tactic tags inside an encounter file, and no sheet anywhere. ⚠️ CCode's matrix measured the consequence: 'every function any opponent can declare, in the whole game: strike, shield', and the win rate correlated with THREAT at −0.95 — ⛔ because threat was nearly the only authored number that varied. ⚑ THE EIGHT CELLS EXIST TO PROVE EVERY CONTRIBUTION FAMILY CAN WIN A FIGHT. They cannot prove it while every champion fights identically. ⚠️ Crafts are drawn from the encounter's OWN prose and tactic tags — nothing invented.
questSeeds: ⚑ He wants to meet a pattern he cannot call. Fight him twice and change nothing, then change one thing, and he will want to know how.
⚠️ He has been calling a tell for a competitor who does not know they have it, and it is getting them hurt in other bouts. He has not worked out how to say so.
_questSeedsWhy: ⚑ SNG-167 §2 — an errand this person would ASK for, drawn from their own `wants` and `fears`. ⚠️ Authored with the champion because the ratchet caught eight new people carrying a want and no seed, which is exactly what it is for. ⛔ A coliseum champion is not only an opponent — 'the memorable arcs start with someone'.
